scenarios.name: Collection helpers for a small stationery order desk
scenarios.summary: A fictional stationery order desk uses small Python helpers to pair notebook, pen and pencil labels with quantities, summarize blue and red labels, copy nested lists before appending, inspect a text-to-quantity conversion, and document an order-cost calculation. The supplied examples are authored practice inputs, not real orders.
